hoḥdagongs su gsol/'dzam gling seng chen rgyal po lha klu gnyan gyi dmag dpon pad+ma'i pho nya/dmu bdud 'jang gsum kha gnon/gsang sngags bstan pa'i srung ma/ra

tei:div.tei:p: hoḥ dgongs su gsol/ 'dzam gling seng chen rgyal po lha klu gnyan gyi dmag dpon pad+ma'i pho nya/ dmu bdud 'jang gsum kha gnon/ gsang sngags bstan pa'i srung ma/ rnal 'byor skyong ba'i dgra bla/ lha mi gnyis kyi mgon po/ 'dzam bu gling gi mnga' bdag mi dam ldan gyi srung ma/ slob bu dam log gi gshed ma/ 'jig rten gyi phud la dgyes pa/ srog la dga' ba/ dgra bla skyes bu don 'grub/ 'khor gling dkar gyi dpa' thul sum cu/ lha klu gnyan gyi dgra bla/ rma stod rma rgyal spom ra/ rtse lha bcu gsum sogs 'dzam bu gling gi gzhi bdag dang dkar phyogs skyong ba'i tshogs kyis mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ sems can gyi bde skyid spel/ rnal 'byor ba'i mgon skyabs mdzod/ sdang ba'i dgra sod/ gnod pa'i bgegs thul/ byad phur rbod gtong rnams rang gshed rang la phob/ dam chos byang chub bsgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad sol/ mthun rkyen smon pa'i legs tshogs yongs su 'grub pa'i phrin las dang sdong grogs rgya chen po mdzad du gsol/
'di ni rgan po'i kha smon yin no//
